Commentary.Commentary: So, 243 is the target for the visitors to level the series. It won't be an easy chase for Zimbabwe on this two-paced wicket. Porterfield will be hoping that his bowlers can give them the early breakthrough they need. So, join us in a while for Zimbabwe's response.

As for Zimbabwe's bowling, they were all economical in the end but the star of the show was Solomon Mire. He gave them the breakthrough Zimbabwe were desperately looking for. Picking up the first 4 wickets all by himself. The other bowlers then followed his lead. The spin duo of Raza and Williams scalped two each while Jarvis was the 4th bowler to get a wicket.

After being put into bat, Ireland got off to a good start with both the openers setting the platform with a solid 111-run opening stand. Paul Stirling continued his fine form and scored yet another 50, whereas James McCollum got to his maiden one. But once Stirling departed wickets started falling like nine-pins. From 111/0 Ireland found themselves struggling at 188/5. Lorcan Tucker though fought from one end and it was his maiden ODI fifty which took Ireland close to 250.

Brilliant comeback from Zimbabwe. They were looking all down and out in the first 20 overs where it looked like Ireland will score more than 275 but the visitors then did extremely well to pull things back and restrict them to 242.
Short of a length delivery, Rankin pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run. IRELAND END THEIR INNINGS WITH 242/9 IN 50 OVERS.

Follows it up with a solid back foot defense to end the over.
FOUR! First boundary of the day and Stirling after 6 dots is off the mark with a slashing boundary. Short around off, Paul rocks onto his back foot and pulls it hard over mid-wicket.
The scoreboard is underway. Back of a length ball on off, McCollum strokes it towards cover and takes a single.
Back of a length ball on off, James taps it towards backward point.
Good length delivery on off, McCollum keeps it out.
Outside off, McCollum lets it go.
Tendai Chatara to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
On a good length on middle, Stirling defends it off the back foot. A maiden to start with by Kyle Jarvis.
Full and outside off, Paul drives it to covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Stirling offers no shot to this one.
BEATEN! Beauty of a delivery! On a good length and outside off, Stirling looks to defend but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Full on off, Stirling drives it to covers.
Starts with a good length delivery on middle, Stirling keeps it out. There is no swing on this one.

Done and dusted with the national anthems. We are all set to begin. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and James McCollum will open the batting for Ireland. Kyle Jarvis will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.
The players are out in the middle for National Anthem. First up it will be the visitors followed by the home sides. We are not far away from the start.
Ireland Playing XI - Paul Stirling, James McCollum, Andrew Balbirnie, William Porterfield (C), Kevin O Brien, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Shane Getkate, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Tim Murtagh, Boyd Rankin.

Zimbabwe Playing XI - Hamilton Masakadza(C), Solomon Mire, Craig Ervine, Brendan Taylor (WK), Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Donald Tiripano, Kyle Jarvis, Tendai Chatara, Richmond Mutumbami.
TOSS - Zimbabwe win the toss and elect to field first.

A warm welcome to Match 2 of the three-match ODI series between Ireland and Zimbabwe in Belfast. The hosts have started the series in a strong manner and would look to seal the series today itself. Balbirnie showed great class with his batting in the last match and they would want Paul Stirling to play a big innings. On the other hand, Zimbabwe have lots to ponder about. They would want their batsmen to do well and try to put a big score if they bat first. They would want to improve their bowling from the last match. Stay tuned for the toss.
